source.attribution: Israel Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security, "Agricultural parcels for analysis", https://moag.maps.arcgis.com/home/item.html?id=7d49dd443df440999a05965dbb005d0a
source.disclaimer: Screening by SPFI using Ministry of Agriculture data. Not an official Ministry of Agriculture assessment or recommendation.

methodology.eligibilitySql: CoverType='שטח פתוח' AND Dunam >= 20 AND Dunam <= 250 AND GrowthName IS NOT NULL AND AnafName <> 'לא מעובד'
methodology.selection: Top 500 parcels nationally by field-level screening score (ties: larger area first, then parcel ID). No district quota or locality cap. Fields overlapping an area where TAMA 1/24 (section 3.5.1) does not allow agrivoltaics are excluded: nature reserves and national parks, forests, coastal complexes, urban coastal parks, the coastal environment zone (TAMA 1) and landscape complexes (TAMA 35). Proposals in TAMA 1/26, the coastal fabric, high landscape-environmental sensitivity and flood areas are flagged, not excluded. Parcels whose exact geometry overlaps a current AGRO plan (≥ 5% of parcel or ≥ 2000 m²) are excluded; smaller boundary slivers are kept and flagged as edge contact.
methodology.priorityBands: Absolute score thresholds: high ≥ 80, medium ≥ 60, otherwise early. Bands rank evidence and screening readiness, not technical suitability.
methodology.identifiers: candidateId and sourceParcelId use the ministry parcel ID, which survived the 2026 layer reload. sourceFeatureId (OBJECTID) and sourceGlobalId are volatile and must not be used as keys.
methodology.dates: sourceRecordDate is the ministry Up_Date field: the date the database record was last updated (confirmed by the Ministry of Agriculture, Nov 2026), not the date the crop was observed in the field. Year-only values are marked precision "year". sourceUpdatedAt is a system edit timestamp.

untranslatedCrops: מלון סתיו במינהרות ובשפ (2 מחזורים בשנה)-ערבה

environmentSource.attribution: Source: Israel Ministry of Environmental Protection (המשרד להגנת הסביבה). Geographic data reproduced for research and informational purposes.
environmentSource.note: Preliminary screening indicator from the Ministry sensitivity units; not an official environmental assessment. retrievedAt is a retrieval date, not the date of the underlying assessment.

gridSource.basis: distance from the field centre to the nearest mapped ≥110 kV line and ≥110 kV substation; bands only
gridSource.note: Distance bands to mapped infrastructure, not available connection capacity. No connection offer, reservation or approval.

terrainSource.dem: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (1 arcsecond), tiles N29–N33 × E034–E035
terrainSource.method: Horn 3×3 slope at every DEM pixel whose centre lies inside the parcel; mean and 90th percentile; share steeper than 10% (5.71°); north-facing share = slope ≥ 3° and aspect 315–45°

The organisations in charge of the Copernicus programme by law or by delegation do not incur any liability for any use of the Copernicus WorldDEM-30.

solarSource.referenceSystem: 1 kWp, free-standing, optimal fixed tilt and azimuth, 14% system loss, DEM horizon
solarSource.note: Solar-resource indicator for the area (about 5 km cells), not a yield estimate for an agrivoltaic design. Not part of the screening score.
